messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty AUTO-PAGE fired: gpu-node-248 (rack-14) — kernel panic detected, no serial heartbeat, kubelet NotReady. Alert: PD#3476 -> page to oncall.

maya: acked. I'm on it, standing up serial console.

maya: sshing to BMC - couldn't reach IPMI, serial shows last logs attached:
```
[ 1234.567890] kernel panic - not syncing: watchqueue timeout
[ 1234.568000] CPU: 0 PID: 1 Comm: systemd Not tainted
[ 1234.568500] Call trace:
  dump_stack+0x123/0x200
  panic+0x456/0x700
```

alex: @maya if node is still alive we can try a remote kexec, but if serial's dead we should cordon/evac first.

maya: nodes are still scheduling a few pods: `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-248`

jamie: starting tenant-swap, moving realtime-embed-traffic off node-248 via router rule; will throttle new allocations.

lucia: Support reporting customers in us-west seeing embedding timeouts ~5-10s increased for a subset. Ticket #12345.

maya: cordoning node now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-248
kubectl drain gpu-node-248 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty Alert updated: acknowledged by maya. Escalation timer set 5m -> if no response escalate to alex.

rohit: NVMe SMART shows some errors earlier, pushing logs to /tmp/gpu-248-smarts.log

maya: drain failing on a stuck pod (node-exporter-plugin) — forcing delete.

maya: forced eviction complete, 42 pods rescheduled. Some GPU pass-through workloads failed; jamie opening quick rollback for affected tenants.

jamie: spinning up replacement host from spare pool (gpu-spare-02) — ETA 4m.

alex: taking over monitoring; maya please handoff if you need sleep. :wave: 

maya: handoff done. Triggering reimage via fleetctl:
```
fleetctl reprovision --node gpu-node-248 --image prod-ubuntu-rt-2025-03
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page remains open — reimage in progress. If reprovision fails, will escalate to hardware-RMA after 10m.

lucia: told affected customers we're investigating; sending interim status in 10. Flagged SLA impact to ops.

eng-sre: post-incident action: capture kernel oops + nvme error dumps, assign to eng-runtime and infra for deep triage. Creating postmortem ticket ENG-PI-248.

maya: last check: replacement host up, routing adjusted, most customers cleared. Leaving follow-ups and closing handoff. :thumbsup:
